learning_objective: 🎯 Understand the amazing difference between staying healthy and training your body to be super fast, strong, and perfectly balanced!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Health-related fitness keeps your heart and lungs healthy so you don't fall sick easily. Motor fitness is what turns you into an athlete, giving you the power to jump higher, run faster, and react instantly!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🐆 The Need for Speed and Agility
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Speed is how fast you can run in a straight line, while agility is your superpower to change direction quickly without falling over. Both are super important for sports like football and kabaddi.
Coordination is the teamwork between your brain and your muscles! It helps you perfectly time a jump to catch a ball or swing a racket exactly when the shuttlecock arrives.

fun_activity.title: 🏆 The Digroz Learning Balance Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Stand safely on one leg like a flamingo, then close your eyes! See if your motor fitness allows you to hold your balance for 30 seconds without wobbling or putting your foot down.

quick_recap: ⭐ Physical fitness is your baseline for health, while motor fitness makes you a skilled athlete.
⭐ Agility allows you to dodge and change directions smoothly during intense games.
⭐ Good coordination trains your eyes, brain, and body to react as one perfect unit.
